title: The Hit From Behind
setup: March 2004. Vancouver's Todd Bertuzzi attacks Colorado's Steve Moore from behind, strikes him in the back of the head and pushes his head down onto the ice. Moore lands face-first with Bertuzzi on top of him. Bertuzzi is about to throw another punch when a Moore teammate stops him.
question: What does the NHL's Colin Campbell decide?
options: A suspension for the rest of the regular season and the playoffs, with next season left to the commissioner
A fine only, since the play was ruled a fight
ruling: Campbell suspended Bertuzzi for the rest of the regular season and the playoffs. Commissioner Gary Bettman would decide Bertuzzi's eligibility for next season before training camp, taking Moore's health and recovery into account. The Canucks were fined $250,000. Campbell said, "It was wrong."
rulebookNote: The page, dated March 11, 2004, says the incident was on "Monday night," so the likely date is March 8. It does not describe Moore's injury.
